name: nuxtjs-seo
works_with: Any AI agent that loads skills, on Nuxt 4.6.1 or later projects
short: Helps your agent install, configure and debug Nuxt SEO: robots, sitemap, OG images, Schema.org, link checks and llms.txt.
what: Nuxt SEO is one module that installs nine others for a Nuxt site: robots.txt, sitemaps, Schema.org data, OG images, meta tags, a link checker, site config, `llms.txt` and skew protection. This skill tells your agent what the bundle adds, which config key belongs to which module, how to switch one off, and the common traps, like OG images failing in production without `NUXT_APP_SECRET`.
who: Nuxt developers setting up or upgrading SEO on a Nuxt 4 site, especially moving from Nuxt SEO v5 to v6. Skip it if you don't use Nuxt. Nuxt 3 sites stay on Nuxt SEO v5, which this skill doesn't cover.
needs: An AI agent that loads skills

steps.title: Get the skill
steps.text: The README points AI agent users to skilld.dev/gh/harlan-zw/nuxt-seo. The skill itself sits in `packages/nuxt-seo/skills/nuxtjs-seo` in the repo.

steps.title: Add the module to your site
Set your site URL and name
steps.text: Add only `@nuxtjs/seo` to `modules`, not the submodules.

steps.title: Turn on OG images if you want them
steps.text: A fresh install has no OG image renderer. Install one, and set `NUXT_APP_SECRET` in production.

steps.title: Check the setup
steps.text: Run the dev server and open the home page. The terminal lists required fixes and tips. In dev, `/__nuxt-seo__/setup.json` shows installed and disabled modules.

try.label: From the README
try.text: After deploying, check how readable your site is for AI agents: `npx @vercel/agent-readability audit https://your-site.com`

watch: Production OG image requests return 500 without `NUXT_APP_SECRET`. Generate one with `npx nuxt-og-image generate-secret`.
In dev, `/robots.txt` blocks all crawlers. Check indexing on a production build.
AI Ready is on by default. It serves Markdown versions of every page and `llms.txt`, and publishes anything in `public/skills/`. MCP tools need a separate opt-in.
Upgrading from v5 is breaking: remove `nuxt-ai-ready` and `nuxt-skew-protection` from `modules`, and update or remove older submodule pins.
Skew Protection keeps old build assets in `node_modules/.cache/nuxt-seo/skew-protection`. Preserve that in CI or set `skewProtection.storage`.
